briefdescription.para: Prints the banner, one line at a time, to stdout.
Writes one error line to stderr: the project name, the argument, and the message.

parameterdescription.para: The argument that the error concerns.

briefdescription.para: Returns the version flag: the double dash and the version word.

simplesect.para: The version flag, built once on first use.

briefdescription.para: Returns the help flag: the double dash and the help word.

simplesect.para: The help flag, built once on first use.

briefdescription.para: Tells whether the arguments are the version request.

simplesect.para: true when the only argument is the version flag.

briefdescription.para: Tells whether the arguments are the help request.

simplesect.para: true when the only argument is the help flag.

briefdescription.para: Writes the project name, the version, and the build commit to stdout.
Tells whether stdout is a terminal.

simplesect.para: true when stdout is a terminal.

briefdescription.para: Prints the banner and the help text to stdout.

detaileddescription.para: The help text is the binary resource files::lingHelp.

briefdescription.para: Appends one report row for a document: its path, its declaration count, and its reference count.

detaileddescription.para: An element whose type is below the reference type is a declaration. Every other element is a reference.

parameterdescription.para: The text that receives the row.

briefdescription.para: Prints the banner and the help text, then reports the path as not found on stderr.

parameterdescription.para: The path that was not found.

briefdescription.para: Resolves the manifest argument against the current working folder, then follows a link to its target.

parameterdescription.para: The command line arguments. The manifest argument is at flagArgIndex.

briefdescription.para: Returns the toolchain argument that follows the manifest argument, without its double dash.

detaileddescription.para: An argument that does not start with a double dash is not a toolchain argument.

parameterdescription.para: The index of the manifest argument.

simplesect.para: The toolchain argument text, or an empty view when the next argument is not one.

briefdescription.para: Tells whether the arguments name a manifest, with or without a toolchain argument.

simplesect.para: true for one argument, or for two arguments whose second argument is a toolchain argument.

briefdescription.para: Dispatches the command line to the version, the help, the not-found report, or the unknown flag error.

detaileddescription.para: A manifest argument, with or without a toolchain argument, goes to the not-found report. A command line with more than one argument, other than a manifest with a toolchain argument, prints the unknown flag error for the argument after the manifest, or for the argument after its toolchain argument. With no argument, the function prints the banner and the help text.

simplesect.para: EXIT_SUCCESS for the version, the help, or no argument, or EXIT_FAILURE for a not-found file or an unknown flag.
